newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian patrol intercepts Italian fishing boat.
newsitem.headline: Croatian patrol intercepts Italian fishing boat.

text.p: A Croatian naval patrol intercepted and detained an Italian fishing boat in the northern Adriatic for illegal fishing in its territorial waters, the state news agency HINA said on Wednesday.
Police took the vessel to the port of Pula where criminal proceedings were started against the boat captain and five crew members, HINA quoted a police statement as saying.
The statement said the boat was spotted on Tuesday evening sailing one km (half a mile) inside Croatian territorial waters.
When the boat tried to escape despite warning shots, naval police fired and hit its mast, after which the vessel stopped.

Domenico Passero, captain of the Italian Adriatic port of Chioggia where the boat was registered, earlier said the port had received an SOS message from the boat after the vessel reported the Croatian patrol had fired shots in its vicinity.
He said the six were taken to Pula and "have been unable to contact anyone".
A spokesman said the Italian Foreign Ministry had opened an emergency room to monitor the situation, but he gave no further details.
